About Me

I've spent 3+ years where reporting meets the business: ticketing and operations data at Fresh Electric, Azure pipelines and Power BI at Dirah, and now client-facing BI at Select Company.

At Select Company I work directly with stakeholders from STC and Planon. They tell me what they need to see, and I turn it into PostgreSQL data models and Power BI and Grafana dashboards, validating the data before it reaches a report.
